android.desc:
Opper is the intelligent to-do list that prioritizes your tasks for you — so you can feel confident that you’re getting the right things done.  
 
Create any task and Opper automatically organizes your to-do list based on what matters most to you. 
 
Get organized in seconds by creating dedicated boards for individual projects, teams at work, professional goals, fitness regimes, your personal life — anything. 
 
Need to collaborate on or delegate a task? Share any task with teammates and see if you’re aligned on a task’s urgency and importance using three simple sliders (no meetings or Slack messages required). 
 
Whatever matters most to you, Opper simplifies prioritization so you can make greater progress towards what matters most. 
 
Here’s what you can do with Opper:
 
- Create tasks in as little as 5 seconds 
- Rank tasks with easy-to-use sliders for impact, effort, and urgency .
- Instantly understand which tasks matter most with Opper’s invisible intelligence .
- Confidently prioritize tasks across your entire life by viewing multiple boards at once.
- Delegate or collaborate on tasks by adding teammates to any board or task .
- Measure alignment across teams and your entire company for any task.
- Set deadlines and create recurring tasks.
- Collaborate on projects by sharing tasks with others.
- Create boards to organize tasks across your work and personal life.
